notes: Reordered the Academy tutorial so it teaches the basics first (the battlefield, playing a follower, combat, ending your turn) instead of opening with an advanced mechanic before you knew what a zone or a follower even was. Also fixed several buttons and tabs on the Home, Battle Setup, and Collection screens where the highlighted/selected color and the text color were rendering the same, making buttons look like empty outlined bubbles with no visible label.
fixes: The Academy tutorial used to open its very first lesson with Second Chance and Momentum -- a discard-for-value trade-off with real cost math -- before teaching what a zone, a follower, or a turn even was. Lessons are now ordered: the battlefield, playing a follower, combat, ending your turn, spells & amulets, keywords, Recovery & Revive, then Second Chance (which now builds on Recovery instead of coming before it), signature cards, sponsor, and deck building last.

The gold BATTLE button and ENTER BATTLE button on the Home screen, the active deck-mode button and BEGIN BATTLE button on the Battle Setup screen, and the selected class/rarity filter tabs on the Collection screen were all drawing their dark label text on top of a background that stayed nearly black instead of actually filling with the highlight color -- so the text was nearly invisible and only a colored outline showed. All five now fill with a real solid highlight so the label is legible.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
